'''Vestar''' was the [[Icarii]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] located within the [[Vestar system/Legends|Vestar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was invaded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Icarii Campaign|campaign]] to subdue the Icarii, a conflict that ended in the extermination of the entire species through biological warfare.
